label: Advanced
blurb: The register of memos, meetings and school news — plus the high-frequency 成語 (idioms) that actually turn up in a principal's speech or a newsletter. Every idiom here is one you will genuinely meet on campus.
blurbZh: 公文、會議與校園新聞的語域，再加上校長致詞與校刊裡真的會出現的高頻成語。這裡收的每一個成語，都是你在校園裡遇得到的。
idiomRatio: 10 of 30 questions in this pilot are 成語 items.

questions.q: The office says your workshop expenses still need 核銷. You must —
opts: submit receipts so the expense can be settled and reimbursed
questions.why: 核銷 (héxiāo) is the accounting step where receipts are checked and the expense is written off against the budget. No 核銷, no reimbursement — always keep the 收據 (shōujù).

questions.q: Your director asks you to help prepare a 簽呈. This is —
opts: an internal memo routed for approval
questions.why: 簽呈 (qiānchéng) is the internal request memo that travels up the chain for signatures. 公文 (gōngwén) is the broader term for official documents.

questions.q: An email asks who the 承辦人 for the bilingual project is. They want to know —
opts: the staff member handling the case day to day
questions.why: 承辦人 (chéngbànrén) is the person actually responsible for a case or project. When you're asked 誰是承辦人？they want the name to contact, not the boss.

questions.q: A plan is titled 教師專業精進計畫. 精進 here means —
questions.why: 精進 (jīngjìn) = to refine and advance. 教師專業精進 is the standard label for teacher professional development programmes.

questions.q: The 108 curriculum guidelines call for 素養導向教學. This means teaching that is —
opts: competency-oriented — knowledge applied in real situations
questions.why: 素養 (sùyǎng) = competency or literacy in the broad sense. 素養導向 shifts the goal from memorising content to using it in authentic contexts.

questions.q: You're invited to design a 跨領域 course with the science teacher. This course is —
questions.why: 跨領域 (kuà lǐngyù) = across subject domains. English + science or English + arts co-taught units are the most common form for FETs.

questions.q: Your name appears on the schedule for 教學觀摩 next month. You will —
opts: teach a demonstration lesson that other teachers observe
observe a colleague and write a report
be formally evaluated for your contract
questions.why: 教學觀摩 (jiàoxué guānmó) is the open demonstration lesson. It is professional sharing, not a performance review — the review term is 教學評鑑 (jiàoxué píngjiàn).

questions.q: You can claim 差旅費 for attending the county workshop. This covers —
questions.why: 差旅費 (chāilǚfèi) = travel expenses for official business. Keep tickets and receipts — they go into the 核銷 (héxiāo) paperwork.

questions.zh: 這份公文要在星期五之前回覆
questions.py: zhè fèn gōngwén yào zài xīngqíwǔ zhīqián huífù
questions.q: 🔊 Listen. You are being told that something must be replied to before Friday. What is it?
questions.why: 公文 (gōngwén) = official document. They arrive with a 期限 (qíxiàn, deadline), and missing it is taken seriously by the office.

questions.q: A document is submitted 報教育處備查. This means it is sent to the Education Bureau —
opts: for approval before it can proceed
to be filed for the record
questions.why: 備查 (bèichá) = filed for reference — no approval needed, it just has to be on record. Contrast 核定 (hédìng), which does require approval.

questions.zh: 我們學校的英語成績名列前茅
questions.py: wǒmen xuéxiào de yīngyǔ chéngjī míng liè qián máo
questions.q: The principal says 我們學校的英語成績名列前茅. This means the results are —
questions.why: 名列前茅 (míng liè qián máo) = to rank among the top. The 前茅 were the reed banners carried at the front of an ancient army — hence 'out in front'.

questions.q: A speaker praises a teacher for 因材施教. They are describing teaching that —
opts: adapts to each student's ability and character
questions.why: 因材施教 (yīn cái shī jiào) = teach according to the material you have — the student. It comes from Confucius and is the standard phrase for differentiated instruction.

questions.q: Which situation best fits 一石二鳥?
opts: A lesson that has to be repeated twice
Two teachers disagreeing on a plan
A project that fails despite great effort
An English camp that also builds students' confidence
questions.why: 一石二鳥 (yì shí èr niǎo) = one stone, two birds — exactly the English 'kill two birds with one stone'. 一舉兩得 (yì jǔ liǎng dé) means the same thing.

questions.py: xué yǔyán yào xún xù jiàn jìn
questions.q: 學語言要循序漸進 advises learners to —
opts: advance step by step in proper order
questions.why: 循序漸進 (xún xù jiàn jìn) = follow the sequence and progress gradually. You will hear it whenever curriculum design is discussed.

questions.q: Using the right teaching tool can make your work 事半功倍 — that is —
opts: half the effort, double the result
double the effort, half the result
twice as long but more thorough
questions.why: 事半功倍 (shì bàn gōng bèi) = half the work, twice the effect. Its opposite, 事倍功半 (shì bèi gōng bàn), flips the two characters and the meaning — watch the word order.

questions.q: Teachers must accumulate enough 研習時數 each year. These are —
questions.why: 研習時數 (yánxí shíshù) are the certified in-service training hours, logged on the 全國教師在職進修網 platform.

questions.q: Your bilingual club is counted as 校訂課程. This means it is —
opts: mandated by the Ministry of Education
a temporary pilot with no credit
designed by the school itself within the national framework
questions.why: 校訂課程 (xiàodìng kèchéng) is the school-designed portion of the curriculum, as opposed to 部訂課程 (bùdìng kèchéng), the ministry-mandated core.

questions.q: An official letter ends with 請惠予協助. This is —
opts: a warning that action is overdue
a formal 'your kind assistance would be appreciated'
a statement that the matter is closed
questions.why: 請惠予協助 (qǐng huì yǔ xié zhù) is set 公文 politeness — literally 'please graciously grant assistance'. Nobody says this out loud; it lives in writing.

questions.q: A project document lists the 期程. This section gives the —
questions.why: 期程 (qíchéng) = the time frame or schedule of a plan. Paired terms you'll see nearby: 期限 (qíxiàn, deadline) and 經費 (jīngfèi, funding).

questions.q: A school motto reads 有教無類. It expresses the belief that —
opts: only motivated students should be taught
education should be offered to everyone regardless of background
classes should be streamed by ability
questions.why: 有教無類 (yǒu jiào wú lèi) = 'in teaching, no categories' — Confucius on universal education. You'll see it carved on school walls across Taiwan.

questions.py: zhè liǎng ge bǎnběn dà tóng xiǎo yì
questions.q: A colleague says the two lesson plans are 大同小異. They are —
opts: mostly the same with minor differences
questions.why: 大同小異 (dà tóng xiǎo yì) = largely alike, slightly different. Useful when comparing textbook versions or draft documents.

questions.q: Your co-teaching plan must go to the 課發會. This is the —
questions.why: 課發會 (kèfāhuì) is short for 課程發展委員會 — the in-school committee that reviews and approves curriculum plans each year.

questions.q: The bureau is coming for 訪視 next week. The school is preparing for —
questions.why: 訪視 (fǎngshì) is the formal site visit by a supervising body. Expect tidy classrooms, prepared documents, and a possible request to teach a short demo.

questions.q: A retiring principal is praised as 腳踏實地. They were —
opts: down-to-earth and steady in their work
questions.why: 腳踏實地 (jiǎo tà shí dì) = feet planted on solid ground — practical, reliable, no shortcuts. High praise in a Taiwanese workplace.

questions.q: A workshop is titled 教師增能工作坊. 增能 means —
questions.why: 增能 (zēngnéng) = capacity building, literally 'increase ability'. It appears constantly in bilingual education programme titles.

questions.q: A teacher who is 精益求精 —
opts: keeps improving even when already good
questions.why: 精益求精 (jīng yì qiú jīng) = already fine, yet seeking finer still. It's the phrase used in awards and commendations.

questions.q: A homeroom teacher mentions doing 家訪 this weekend. They will —
questions.why: 家訪 (jiāfǎng) = home visit. It is still common in rural Changhua schools, especially for students facing difficulties.

questions.q: Visitors say the renovated English classroom is 耳目一新. They found it —
questions.why: 耳目一新 (ěr mù yī xīn) = ears and eyes made new — a pleasantly fresh impression. Common in school news write-ups.

questions.q: The director suggests a 微調 to your syllabus. They want —
questions.why: 微調 (wēitiáo) = fine-tuning, a small adjustment. If they wanted a rebuild they'd say 重新規劃 (chóngxīn guīhuà).

questions.q: You're asked to join 雙語共備 every Wednesday. This is —
opts: collaborative lesson planning with the subject teacher
questions.why: 共備 (gòngbèi) is short for 共同備課 — teachers planning a lesson together. For FETs this is the core of co-teaching with a Taiwanese partner.
